description: This file contains shell script functions related to upgrading firmware on Sony devices running OpenWRT. It includes functions for updating boot configuration partitions and executing the overall emmc upgrade process, including flashing kernels and root filesystems, formatting partitions, and performing backups.

methods.name: update_bootconfig
methods.description: Updates specific boot configuration partitions by modifying bytes at given offsets and indices, handling two potential partitions '0:BOOTCONFIG' and '0:BOOTCONFIG1'.

methods.name: sony_emmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade process on Sony devices: identifies relevant partitions, updates boot configs, flashes kernel and root filesystem, formats rootfs_data partition, handles backup configurations, and reboots.
